tests.description: Server-unit RED tests for provider adapter and ADR-B011 release gating.
acceptance_criteria_covered: Valid sandbox configuration delivers through the server-only provider adapter.
Absent, invalid, preview-only, and unapproved real-recipient release states make no provider call.

tests.description: Database-backed RED tests for sandbox delivery, fail-closed release posture, and suppression-before-send.
acceptance_criteria_covered: One sandbox provider-backed sent outcome is recorded without exposing recipient or template data.
Closed release posture makes no provider call and leaves work queued.
Existing suppression and tenant/category isolation remain effective before send.

tests.description: Integration RED tests for current authorized quote-PDF attachment handling and terminal reminder stops.
acceptance_criteria_covered: Valid quote delivery uses current authorized PDF bytes with no public acceptance link.
Stale, invalid, and missing PDFs fail before provider submission and preserve recoverability.
Accepted, rejected, withdrawn, superseded, and expired quotes stop reminders.

tests.description: RLS and public-token RED tests for tenant isolation, hashed capability storage, uniform inactive responses, and fixed-window limits.
acceptance_criteria_covered: A token changes only allowed non-essential scope and cannot affect another tenant/category.
Unknown and revoked public tokens have one minimal inactive response.
Token and IP rate limits return retry-guided 429 without privileged disclosure.

tests.description: Static/server containment RED tests for the narrow provider allowlist and anonymous unsubscribe shell boundary.
acceptance_criteria_covered: Provider credentials and recipient/template data stay server-only.
Unsubscribe has no authenticated-shell imports or privileged capability.

fixture_needs: Service-role test client injected only in server/integration dependencies
Anon Supabase client for unsubscribe-token RLS proof
Deterministic release-control and fixed-window clock fixtures
summary: Generated 12 skipped, expected-to-fail server-unit, static, integration, and RLS acceptance scenarios for Story 13.4. All delivery scenarios use a synthetic sandbox recipient; real-recipient delivery is deliberately owner-gated by ADR-B011.
